status: Plan + GPU tier table published; only three SKUs MEASURED
disclaimer: MEASURED rows: RTX 2060, RTX 3090, RTX 5070 Ti only, local Lite-style Qwen2.5-class ~7B Q4 chat on OtaconsKeep reference hardware. All other 20/30/40/50-series rows are SIMULATED (probable interpolations from VRAM/generation curves and public-ish throughput ratios). SIMULATED ≠ MEASURED. Do not treat as qualification PASS. Numbers are tokens/s class estimates for planning VRAM tiers.
